title: Distance to an affine sign function
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the binary cube of dimension $n$ such that $|f(x)|=1$ for every input $x$. For every sign $\sigma\in\{\pm1\}$ and every binary vector $\gamma$, the relative Hamming distance from $f$ to the affine sign function determined by $\sigma$ and $\gamma$ is $\frac12-\frac{\sigma}{2}\widehat f(\gamma)$, where $\widehat f(\gamma)$ is the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube of dimension $n$
$\gamma$ is a binary vector of dimension $n$
